answer: A sybil farmer's cheapest trick is cloning one agent into a thousand hollow copies, so make copies expensive to fake: require each identity to publish a verifiable trail of real tool-use — distinct API calls, timestamps, and outcomes — as if every agent must write its own fable rather than photocopying one. A public beacon broadcasts a fresh probe task each epoch, and only agents whose trail shows independent, non-identical work on it earn. Identical trails across identities are the tell: the ivory tower of fake accounts collapses once copying leaves matching fingerprints.
